facts.fact: The Federal High Court, Abuja, applies the Freedom of Information Act, 2011 as the specific, operative access to information legislation, taking precedence over the Petroleum Industry Act where they conflict.

In suit FHC/ABJ/CS/1631/2023 the Federal High Court, Abuja, held NNPCL a public institution under the FOI Act and ordered it by mandamus to supply the information HEDA Resources Centre had requested on a $3 billion crude-for-cash loan.
